verdict.rationale: Runpod's own docs describe Serverless flex workers that "scale to zero when idle" for variable workloads. Billing is per second, from when a worker starts until it fully stops. Developers deploy their own code to Serverless endpoints via Flash (`@Endpoint` functions with GPU workers), the CLI, and SDKs. missing for 10: detailed documentation of autoscaling behavior (worker min/max limits, scaling triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration of scale-to-zero serverless deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Flex workers | Scale to zero when idle | Standard per-second rate | Variable workloads, cost optimization
